chunks: Yunus narrated from Dawood al-Raqqi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to Musa ibn Imran (peace be upon him): 'O son of Imran! Do not envy the people for what I have given them from My grace, and do not extend your eyes towards that, and do not let your soul follow it, for the envious one is displeased with My bounties, obstructing My apportionment which I have apportioned among My servants. And whoever is like that, then I am not from him and he is not from Me.'

key_terms.فَلَسْتُ مِنْهُ: Then I am not from him

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of envy according to the hadith of Musa (AS)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this Hadith Qudsi emphasizes that envy is not merely a psychological state but a theological rejection of Allah’s wisdom in distributing rizq (sustenance) among His servants. The phrase 'I am not from him, and he is not from Me' underscores the mutual alienation between the Divine and the envious, a concept deeply explored in Shia tafsir as a loss of spiritual proximity. This narration serves as a practical guide for cultivating contentment (qana'ah) by recognizing that all blessings are specific manifestations of divine will rather than arbitrary luck.

en.hubeali:
Yunus, from Dawood Al Raqqy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said to Musa<sup>as</sup> Bin Imran<sup>as</sup>: “O son<sup>as</sup> of Imran<sup>as</sup>! Neither should you envy the people upon what I<sup>azwj</sup> have Given them from My<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, nor should you<sup>as</sup> extend your<sup>as</sup> eyes towards that, and do not follow it yourself<sup>as</sup>, for the envying one gets angered at My<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties, blocks My<sup>azwj</sup> Apportionment which I<sup>azwj</sup> have Apportioned between My<sup>azwj</sup> servant. And the one who is such as that, so I<sup>azwj</sup> am not from him and he is not from Me<sup>azwj</sup>”’.
en.sarwar: 6. Yunus has narrated from Dawud al-Riqqi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, said to Moses, “O son of ‘Imran, do not envy people for what I have given them of My favors, do not focus your eyes on it (what I have given to people), and do not allow your soul to follow it; an envious person is angry with My bounties, and blocks My distribution (favors) among My servants. Whoever is as such, I am not for him, and he is not from Me.’”
